verses.en: Behold, the LORD’S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.pt: Eis que a mão do SENHOR não está encolhida, para que não possa salvar; nem seu ouvido surdo, para não poder ouvir.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save; nor his ear dull, that it can’t hear.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, the Lord's hand has not become short, so that he is unable to give salvation; and his ear is not shut from hearing:

verses.en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.pt: Porém vossas perversidades fazem separação entre vós e vosso Deus; e vossos pecados encobrem o rosto dele de vós, para que não ouça.
verses.en_web: But your iniquities have separated you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.
verses.en_bbe: But your sins have come between you and your God, and by your evil doings his face has been veiled from you, so that he will give you no answer.

verses.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.pt: Porque vossas mãos estão contaminadas de sangue, e vossos dedos de maldade; vossos lábios falam falsidade, vossa língua pronuncia perversidade.
verses.en_web: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters wickedness.
verses.en_bbe: For your hands are unclean with blood, and your fingers with sin; your lips have said false things, and your tongue gives out deceit.

verses.en: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.pt: Ninguém há que clame pela justiça, nem ninguém que defenda causa em juízo por meio da verdade; confiam naquilo que é inútil, e falam mentiras; são causadores de opressão, e geram injustiça;
verses.en_web: No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief, and give birth to iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: No one puts forward an upright cause, or gives a true decision: their hope is in deceit, and their words are false; they are with child with sin, and give birth to evil.

verses.en: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.pt: Chocam ovos de serpente, e tecem teias de aranha; quem comer de seus ovos morrerá, e sairá uma cobra venenosa se forem pisados.
verses.en_web: They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks out into a viper.
verses.en_bbe: They give birth to snake's eggs, and make spider's threads: whoever takes their eggs for food comes to his death, and the egg which is crushed becomes a poison-snake.

verses.en: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.pt: Suas teias não servem para vestimentas, nem poderão se cobrir com suas obras; suas obras são obras de injustiça, e atos de violência há em suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Their webs won’t become garments. They won’t cover themselves with their works. Their works are works of iniquity, and acts of violence are in their hands.
verses.en_bbe: Their twisted threads will not make clothing, and their works will give them nothing for covering themselves: their works are works of sin, and violent acts are in their hands.

verses.en: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.pt: Seus pés correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramarem sangue inocente; seus pensamentos são pensamentos de injustiça, destruição e ruína há em suas estradas.
verses.en_web: Their feet run to evil, and they hurry to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity. desolation and destruction are in their paths.
verses.en_bbe: Their feet go quickly to evil, and they take delight in the death of the upright; their thoughts are thoughts of sin; wasting and destruction are in their ways.

verses.en: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.pt: O caminho da paz eles não conhecem, nem há justiça em seus percursos; entortam suas veredas para si mesmos; todo aquele que anda por elas não experimentará paz.
verses.en_web: They don’t know the way of peace; and there is no justice in their ways. They have made crooked paths for themselves; whoever goes in them doesn’t know peace.
verses.en_bbe: They have no knowledge of the way of peace, and there is no sense of what is right in their behaviour: they have made for themselves ways which are not straight; whoever goes in them has no knowledge of peace.

verses.en: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.pt: Por isso o juízo está longe de nós, nem a justiça nos alcança; esperamos luz, porém eis que há somente trevas; esperamos brilho, porém andamos às escuras.
verses.en_web: Therefore is justice far from us, and righteousness doesn’t overtake us. We look for light, but see darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause our right is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us: we are looking for light, but there is only the dark; for the shining of the sun, but our way is in the night.

verses.en: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.pt: Apalpamos as paredes como cegos, e como se não tivéssemos olhos andamos apalpando; tropeçamos ao meio-dia como se fosse noite; entre os fortes estamos como mortos.
verses.en_web: We grope for the wall like the blind. Yes, we grope as those who have no eyes. We stumble at noon as if it were twilight. Among those who are strong, we are like dead men.
verses.en_bbe: We go on our way, like blind men feeling for the wall, even like those who have no eyes: we are running against things in daylight as if it was evening; our place is in the dark like dead men.

verses.en: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.pt: Todos nós bramamos como ursos, e continuamente gememos como pombas; esperamos pela justiça, e nada acontece; esperamos pela salvação, porem ela está longe de nós.
verses.en_web: We all roar like bears, and moan bitterly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.en_bbe: We make noises of grief, like bears, and sad sounds like doves: we are looking for our right, but it is not there; for salvation, but it is far from us.

verses.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.pt: Pois nossas transgressões se multiplicaram diante de ti, e nossos pecados dão testemunho contra nós; pois nossas transgressões estão conosco, e conhecemos nossas perversidades,
verses.en_web: For our transgressions are multiplied before you, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:
verses.en_bbe: For our evil doings are increased before you, and our sins give witness against us: for our evil doings are with us, and we have knowledge of our sins:

verses.en: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.pt: Tais como: transgredir e mentir contra o SENHOR, e se desviar de seguir a nosso Deus; falar de opressão e rebelião, conceber e falar palavras de falsidade do coração.
verses.en_web: transgressing and denying Yahweh, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.en_bbe: We have gone against the Lord, and been false to him, turning away from our God, our words have been uncontrolled, and in our hearts are thoughts of deceit.

verses.en: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.pt: Por isso que o direito retrocedeu, e a justiça ficou de longe; pois a verdade tropeçou na praça, e a correta decisão não pode entrar.
verses.en_web: Justice is turned away backward, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has fallen in the street, and uprightness can’t enter.
verses.en_bbe: And the right is turned back, and righteousness is far away: for good faith is not to be seen in the public places, and upright behaviour may not come into the town.

verses.en: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.pt: E a verdade se perde, e quem se desvia do mal corre o risco de ser saqueado; e o SENHOR o viu, pareceu mal em seus olhos, por não haver justiça.
verses.en_web: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, faith is gone; and he whose heart is turned from evil comes into the power of the cruel: and the Lord saw it, and he was angry that there was no one to take up their cause.

verses.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.pt: E vendo que ninguém havia, maravilhou-se de que não houvesse intercessor algum; por isso seu próprio braço lhe trouxe a salvação, e sua própria justiça o susteve.
verses.en_web: He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor. Therefore his own arm brought salvation to him; and his righteousness sustained him.
verses.en_bbe: And he saw that there was no man, and was surprised that there was no one to take up their cause: so his arm gave salvation, and he made righteousness his support.

verses.en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.pt: Pois ele se vestu de justiça como uma armadura, e pôs o capacete da salvação em sua cabeça; e vestiu-se de roupas de vingança como vestimenta, e cobriu-se de selo como uma capa.
verses.en_web: He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his head. He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and salvation as a head-dress; and he put on punishment as clothing, and wrath as a robe.

verses.en: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.pt: Ele lhes retribuirá conforme suas obras: furor a seus adversários, pagamento a seus inimigos; aos litorais ele pagará de volta.
verses.en_web: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; he will repay the islands their due.
verses.en_bbe: He will give them the right reward of their doings, wrath to his attackers, punishment to his haters, and even on the sea-lands he will send punishment.

verses.en: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.pt: Então temerão o nome do SENHOR desde o ocidente, e sua glória desde o oriente; pois ele vem como uma correnteza impetuosa, empurrada pelo sopro do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: So shall they fear Yahweh’s name from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which Yahweh’s breath drives.
verses.en_bbe: So they will see the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the east: for he will come like a rushing stream, forced on by a wind of the Lord.

verses.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E um Redentor virá a Sião, para aqueles que se arrependerem de sua transgressão em Jacó, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And as a saviour he will come to Zion, turning away sin from Jacob, says the Lord.

verses.en: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, este é meu pacto com eles,diz o SENHOR; meu Espírito que está sobre ti, e minhas palavras que pus em tua boca, não se afastarão de tua boca nem da boca de teus descendentes, nem da boca dos descendentes de teus descendentes, diz o SENHOR, desde agora e para sempre.
verses.en_web: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says Yahweh, “from henceforth and forever.”
verses.en_bbe: And as for me, this is my agreement with them, says the Lord: my spirit which is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, will not go away from your mouth, or from the mouth of your seed, or from the mouth of your seed's seed, says the Lord, from now and for ever.
